$comment: The pipeline's stages, in order. pipeline/gate.mjs reads this file. Fields: id, agent, summary, outputs (files that must exist), checks (pipeline/lib/checks.mjs), npm (scripts that must exit 0), budget (true: refuse at 100% of the token budget), manual (who confirms), approves (a file pinned by content hash), go (true: the owner's GO for the exact commit), when (kit.config.json values that must match, otherwise the stage is SKIPPED), pending (the phase that builds this stage's gate; until then it is BLOCKED).
